Tasks.title: 待办任务
Tasks.emptyHint: 添加待办后即可处理——agent 在独立 worktree 中工作，你验收并合并结果。
Tasks.listEmpty: 没有符合当前筛选条件的任务
Tasks.badgeMergeQueuedRank: 排队合并 · 第 {rank} 位
Tasks.badgeMergeQueuedHint: 正在等待该项目当前的合并完成，轮到时会自动开始。
Tasks.cancelDescription: 任务将变为已取消，之后可以重新排队。
Tasks.cancelReasonPlaceholder: 例如：方向不对，我重写一下任务描述
Tasks.cancelDeleteWorktree: 同时删除其 worktree 和工作分支
Tasks.restartDescription: 可以补充一段说明（可选），它会随下一轮的提示词一起发给 agent。
Tasks.restartDuplicateSource: {task} 已经在处理同一个工作项——再启动这一张会让同一个工作项上同时活着两个任务。
Tasks.scheduleDescription: 任务留在「待办」，到点自动开始。文件夹的并发上限依然生效。
Tasks.schedulePastHint: 该时间已过——保存后会立即开始。
Tasks.followUpPlaceholderRevise: 希望 agent 改哪里？会在同一会话里继续。
Tasks.followUpPlaceholderContinue: 接下来还要做什么？已有的工作会保留。
Tasks.followUpPlaceholderQuestion: 想了解什么？agent 只回答，不会改动任何文件。
Tasks.followUpPlaceholderVerify: 可选：有什么想让它重点检查的？
Tasks.followUpPlaceholderRetry: 可选：这次要怎么做才不一样？例如：先跑 pnpm install
Tasks.followUpPlaceholderRequeue: 可选：当时为什么取消？这次要注意什么？
Tasks.transcriptDescription: 任务智能体会话的只读实时视图。
Tasks.promptPlaceholder: 向 agent 描述任务——输入 @ 可引用文件，/ 可唤起命令
Tasks.baseBranchDefault: 任务开始时的当前分支
Tasks.baseBranchHint: 任务从该分支拉出工作树，合并时也落回该分支。
Tasks.agentInheritedHint: 继承自任务设置，修改后仅对本任务生效
Tasks.agentNoDefaultHint: 任务设置中没有默认 agent，当前选中的 agent 将随任务保存
Tasks.agentInheritedUnavailableHint: 任务设置中的 {agent} 不可用，当前选中的 agent 将随任务保存
Tasks.mergeQueueHint: 该项目正在合并另一个任务。此任务会加入队列，等前一个完成后自动开始。
Tasks.mergeQueueUpdateHint: 该任务已在合并队列中。提交将更新它的合并选项，并保留原有的排队位置。
Tasks.mergeDescription: 将 {branch} 合并到 {base}。worktree 中未提交的变更会先自动提交。
Tasks.mergeMessagePlaceholder: 例如 feat: add login validation
Tasks.mergeAutoMessage: 让 agent 自动生成提交信息
Tasks.strategySquashHint: 任务的所有修改压缩成一条提交记录并入主分支，历史更简洁。
Tasks.strategyMergeHint: 保留任务过程中的每一条提交，另加一条合并记录，每一步都可追溯。
Tasks.mergeInstructionsPlaceholder: 例如：冲突时以本分支为准
Tasks.mergeQueuedToast: 已加入合并队列，等当前合并完成后自动开始。
Tasks.completeDescription: 该任务没有改动任何文件，无需合并，将直接标记为已完成。
Tasks.completeDescriptionNoWorktree: 该任务的 worktree 已被删除，无法再合并，将直接标记为已完成。若工作分支上仍有未合并的提交，分支会被保留。
Tasks.settingsScopeGlobalHint: 未单独设置的文件夹将使用这份全局默认配置。
Tasks.settingsSourceGlobalFollow: 跟随全局任务设置，全局改动会自动生效。
Tasks.settingsSourceCustomHint: 为此文件夹保存独立设置，不再跟随全局默认。
Tasks.settingsAutoCompactHint: 继续处理、重试或合并前，若会话上下文占用达到该比例，先压缩再发送任务消息。0 表示关闭。
Tasks.settingsCompactCommandHint: 留空则按智能体自身提供的命令（或已知默认值）自动选择。
Tasks.settingsAutoProcessHint: 待办任务自动开始处理，受并发上限约束。
Tasks.settingsMergeStrategyHint: 合并任务时，这些修改在分支历史里如何记录。
Tasks.settingsAutoMergeHint: 任务进入待验收且有可合并改动时自动落地，与点击「合并」相同：提交信息由 agent 自动生成，是否删除 worktree 沿用下方默认。预检未通过或合并失败的任务会留下等你处理。
Tasks.settingsDeleteWorktreeHint: 合并对话框里默认勾选，仍可临时改。
Tasks.settingsWorktreeRootHint: 新任务的 worktree 创建在该目录下，每个任务一个。留空则创建在项目文件夹的同级目录；「~」表示主目录，相对路径相对于项目文件夹。
Tasks.settingsPreflightHint: 任务进入待验收时在 worktree 中运行。
Tasks.settingsInitCommandHint: 新建 worktree 后、会话开始前执行。
Tasks.settingsPromptsIntro: 每个阶段都已内置固定的提示词——任务本身、worktree 规则，合并阶段还包含具体的 git 步骤。这里填的内容会作为补充说明追加到末尾：只是对内置提示词的细化，不会替换它们。
Tasks.settingsPromptPlaceholderAll: 例如：遵循 AGENTS.md 里的项目约定；始终用中文回复
Tasks.settingsPromptPlaceholderWork: 例如：先读相关测试；小步提交，边做边交
Tasks.settingsPromptPlaceholderRetry: 例如：先看清楚已经提交了哪些改动再继续，别重做已完成的部分
Tasks.settingsPromptPlaceholderReturn: 例如：逐条处理提到的每一点；不要顺手重构无关代码
Tasks.settingsPromptPlaceholderMerge: 例如：最终合并的提交信息用中文；手动解决过的冲突要单独说明
Tasks.settingsPromptHintAll: 追加到每一次发给 agent 的提示词，包括合并那一轮。
Tasks.settingsPromptHintRetry: 重试被中断或失败的任务时追加。
Tasks.settingsPromptHintReturn: 对待验收的任务继续处理时追加（返工、追加工作、自查）。
Tasks.settingsPromptHintMerge: agent 把任务合并到基线分支时追加。
Tasks.detailFilesIncludesPr: 含 PR 自身的改动
Tasks.detailFilesIncludesMr: 含 MR 自身的改动
Tasks.deleteConfirmBody: 「{title}」将从看板移除。进行中的运行会先被取消。
Tasks.deleteWorktreeConfirmBody: worktree 目录及其工作分支将被彻底删除。任务仍留在看板上，其会话会移到项目文件夹下。
Tasks.eventResumeFallback: 会话恢复失败，已改用新会话
Tasks.deliverPrDescription: 把该任务的分支推送到 {repo}，并向 {base} 创建 Pull Request。正文会自动关联来源 Issue，PR 合并时 Issue 一并关闭。
Tasks.deliverPrDescriptionMr: 把该任务的分支推送到 {repo}，并向 {base} 创建合并请求。正文会自动关联来源 Issue，合并请求合并时 Issue 一并关闭。
Tasks.deliverPrBackDescription: 把这个任务的提交推到 {repo}#{number} 的头分支 {branch}。不会新建任何东西——工作直接进入已经存在的那个评审。
Tasks.deliverPrBackDescriptionMr: 把这个任务的提交推到 {repo}!{number} 的源分支 {branch}。不会新建任何东西——工作直接进入已经存在的那个评审。

Tasks.title: To-dos
Tasks.emptyHint: Add a to-do, then run it — the agent works in an isolated worktree and you review and merge the result.
Tasks.listEmpty: No tasks match the current filters
Tasks.badgeMergeQueuedHint: Waiting for the project's current merge to finish; this one starts on its own.
Tasks.cancelDescription: The task moves to Canceled, and you can requeue it later.
Tasks.cancelReasonPlaceholder: e.g. wrong approach — I'll rewrite the description
Tasks.cancelDeleteWorktree: Also delete its worktree and work branch
Tasks.restartDescription: Add a note for the agent (optional) — it reaches the prompt of the next run.
Tasks.restartDuplicateSource: {task} is already active on the same work item — restarting this one would leave two live tasks on it.
Tasks.scheduleDescription: The task stays in To do and starts on its own at the time you pick. The folder's concurrency limit still applies.
Tasks.schedulePastHint: That time has passed — the task starts as soon as you save.
Tasks.followUpPlaceholderRevise: What should the agent change? It continues in the same session.
Tasks.followUpPlaceholderContinue: What's next? The work so far stays as it is.
Tasks.followUpPlaceholderQuestion: What do you want to know? The agent answers without touching any file.
Tasks.followUpPlaceholderVerify: Optional: anything it should look at closely?
Tasks.followUpPlaceholderRetry: Optional: what should it do differently? e.g. run pnpm install first
Tasks.followUpPlaceholderRequeue: Optional: why did you cancel it, and what should change this time?
Tasks.notifyReviewRedacted: A task is ready for review
Tasks.transcriptDescription: Read-only live view of the task's agent session.
Tasks.promptPlaceholder: Describe the task for the agent — @ to reference files, / for commands
Tasks.baseBranchDefault: Current branch when the task starts
Tasks.baseBranchHint: The task branches from here, and merging lands it back on this branch.
Tasks.agentInheritedHint: Inherited from task settings — change it to override for this task
Tasks.agentNoDefaultHint: No default agent in task settings — the selected agent will be saved with the task
Tasks.agentInheritedUnavailableHint: {agent} from task settings isn't available — the selected agent will be saved with the task
Tasks.mergeQueueHint: Another task of this project is merging right now. This one joins the queue and starts on its own as soon as that one finishes.
Tasks.mergeQueueUpdateHint: This task is already waiting to merge. Submitting updates it and keeps its place in the queue.
Tasks.mergeDescription: Merge {branch} into {base}. Uncommitted changes in the worktree are committed first.
Tasks.mergeAutoMessage: Let the agent write the commit message
Tasks.strategySquashHint: All the task's changes land in the main branch as a single history entry — a tidier history.
Tasks.strategyMergeHint: Every commit made during the task is kept, plus one merge entry — each step stays traceable.
Tasks.mergeInstructionsPlaceholder: e.g. prefer this branch's side on any conflict
Tasks.mergeQueuedToast: Added to the merge queue — it starts as soon as the current merge finishes.
Tasks.completeDescription: This task changed no files, so there is nothing to merge — it is marked as done directly.
Tasks.completeDescriptionNoWorktree: This task's worktree has been removed, so there is no merge to run — it is marked as done directly. A work branch that still holds unmerged commits is kept.
Tasks.settingsScopeGlobalHint: Folders without their own settings use these global defaults.
Tasks.settingsSourceGlobalFollow: Follows the global task settings — changes there apply here automatically.
Tasks.settingsSourceCustomHint: Saves this folder's own settings; it stops following the global defaults.
Tasks.settingsAutoCompactHint: Before a follow-up, retry or merge round, compact the session when its context window is at least this full. 0 = off.
Tasks.settingsCompactCommandHint: Leave blank to use what the agent offers, or its known default.
Tasks.settingsAutoProcessHint: To-dos start on their own, up to the concurrency limit.
Tasks.settingsMergeStrategyHint: How the task's changes are recorded in the branch history when merged.
Tasks.settingsAutoMergeHint: A task that reaches review with something to land merges as if you clicked Merge: the agent writes the commit message, and the worktree follows the default below. A red preflight or a failed merge leaves the task waiting for you.
Tasks.settingsDeleteWorktreeHint: Pre-selects the option in the merge dialog; you can still change it there.
Tasks.settingsWorktreeRootHint: Directory new task worktrees are created in — one per task. Leave it empty to keep them next to the project folder; "~" is your home directory, and a relative path resolves against the project folder.
Tasks.settingsPreflightHint: Runs in the worktree when a task reaches review.
Tasks.settingsInitCommandHint: Runs inside a freshly created worktree before the agent starts.
Tasks.settingsPromptsIntro: Each stage already sends a built-in prompt — the task itself, the worktree rules, and for merging the exact git steps. Text you add here is appended at the end as extra instructions: it refines those built-ins, it never replaces them.
Tasks.settingsPromptPlaceholderAll: e.g. Follow the conventions in AGENTS.md; keep the final summary to two sentences
Tasks.settingsPromptPlaceholderWork: e.g. Read the related tests first; commit in small steps as you go
Tasks.settingsPromptPlaceholderRetry: e.g. Check what is already committed before continuing; don't redo finished work
Tasks.settingsPromptPlaceholderReturn: e.g. Address every point raised; don't refactor anything unrelated
Tasks.settingsPromptPlaceholderMerge: e.g. Write the landing commit message in English; call out any conflict you resolved by hand
Tasks.settingsPromptHintAll: Appended to every prompt the agent receives, the merge run included.
Tasks.settingsPromptHintWork: Appended when a task runs for the first time.
Tasks.settingsPromptHintRetry: Appended when an interrupted or failed task is picked up again.
Tasks.settingsPromptHintReturn: Appended when you follow up on a reviewed task (rework, extra work, self-check).
Tasks.settingsPromptHintMerge: Appended when the agent lands the task onto the base branch.
Tasks.detailFilesIncludesPr: incl. the pull request's own changes
Tasks.detailFilesIncludesMr: incl. the merge request's own changes
Tasks.detailNoChanges: No changes vs the base yet
Tasks.deleteConfirmBody: “{title}” will be removed from the board. An active run is canceled first.
Tasks.deleteWorktreeConfirmBody: The worktree directory and its work branch are deleted for good. The task stays on the board, and its conversation moves to the project folder.
Tasks.eventResumeFallback: Session resume fell back to a new session
Tasks.deliverPrDescription: Pushes this task's branch to {repo} and opens a pull request against {base}. The issue is linked automatically, so merging it closes the issue.
Tasks.deliverPrDescriptionMr: Pushes this task's branch to {repo} and opens a merge request against {base}. The issue is linked automatically, so merging it closes the issue.
Tasks.deliverPrBackTitle: Deliver back to the pull request
Tasks.deliverPrBackTitleMr: Deliver back to the merge request
Tasks.deliverPrBackDescription: Pushes this task's commits onto {branch}, the head branch of {repo}#{number}. Nothing new is opened — the review that is already there receives the work.
Tasks.deliverPrBackDescriptionMr: Pushes this task's commits onto {branch}, the source branch of {repo}!{number}. Nothing new is opened — the review that is already there receives the work.
